title: Fundamentals of massage
brief_description: Shows proper position of patient for massage; how to perform superficial and deep stroking and the importance of rhythm in stroking; how to knead; how to perform friction; and the value of each type of massage movement. The value of each type of massaging movement are also dealt with.
